description: The answer text of a gate with questions (openspec gate-context, design decision 6): the format of the AskUserQuestion tool result of Claude Code 2.1.331 ("<question>"="<labels>" joined by ", "; multi-select labels joined by ", "; (no option selected) for a question with no pick). picks[i] are the labels that the person picked for question i, in any order; the answer keeps the order of the options. mode is how the card shows the questions. TypeScript (@aw/client/gates) and Kotlin (GateTexts.kt) run the same cases. Source: the format string of mapToolResultToToolResultBlockParam in the Claude Code 2.1.331 binary, read on 2026-11-24; the questions are synthetic (the first case is the PreToolUse.AskUserQuestion capture of plugins/agent-claude/fixtures/hooks-2.1.330.json).

cases.name: two questions, multi-select second

questions.question: Which queue library do we use?

options.label: Library A
options.description: Runs in the same process. No new port.

options.label: Library B
options.description: A separate service. Retries after a restart.

questions.question: Which checks must run before the release?

cases.answer: "Which queue library do we use?"="Library B", "Which checks must run before the release?"="Unit tests, Leak check"

questions.question: Which queue library do we use?
